public_postgresql.scope: Actual public schema at0058, synthetic tenant/call/connector rows and NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS role. Real admission SQL and lead projection, fake provider writes. Account/config/scopes/call/lead/contact insert-delete-withdrawal race negatives, token-only rotation positive, tenant negative. Combined28 cases45.96s. Final following config comparison delta affects only HubSpot ignored raw settings and is covered by2unit controls; final root aggregate remains separate.

behavior: Only a summary matching the current canonical transcript/action digest is submitted.

Primary current source-matched confirmed caller evidence may replace an import. Strongest manual evidence on the same lead prevails; pending/withdrawn/revised evidence suppresses that channel. Numbered or unrelated older caller contacts are not promoted.
Original prepared contact arguments, recipient, provider/account, source versions and digest are committed before resolution/create, and cannot be overwritten by retry.
Unknown contact creates never auto-adopt a broad search result or repeat create; legacy missing snapshots remain held.
Known call-create outcomes retain existing UUID-reference reconciliation in the original pinned account.
Current source/contact authority and fresh pinned connector identity are rechecked before external writes and before a bounded authentication retry.
Existing lead receipt projection exposes original references, phase, sanitized status/error and digest only, never raw effect arguments.

Final admission uses one bounded SQL stamp before and after awaited semantic validation: current call/lead versions, at most2current primary rows plus2winning manual rows, active pinned connector/config and the resolver-selected newest active account/scopes. Absence/insert/delete changes are detected; token-only rotation fields are excluded.

A known safe pre-effect rejection may retry unchanged exact prepared arguments/primary evidence using a fresh call-version CAS. Original contact_effect remains immutable; unknown create is never reopened.
limitations: No real provider, paid telephone call or external write was run; connector operations in fixtures are synthetic.

No provider-neutral explicit contact-ID readback exists in the current CRM contract. Unknown contact creation remains unresolved for original-account support review; this package does not add a blind operator retry or fabricated nonexecution decision.
A write already admitted or submitted cannot be undone by a later correction. Existing effects and original receipts remain historical; uncertain results stay held.
Migration0058 is required before the new receipt projection. No destructive downgrade or legacy snapshot backfill is supported.
The final SQL snapshot is the admission point, not a distributed transaction. A later external account revocation or caller correction cannot atomically cancel an already-admitted remote request.

Missing durable external_account_id cannot be validated by the final stamp even if a legacy runtime lookup discovers an identity; such rows require account reconciliation/reconnection, not a guessed stored identity.

The DB effect snapshot contains bounded original provider arguments, potentially the existing transcript excerpt in Salesforce description; the public receipt projection exposes only availability/digest and provider references.
The final full candidate aggregate is owned by the root agent and is distinct from this scoped evidence.
